narrative.offerRewardText:
You've done well! That's less Templars for me to worry about.

Here you go, adventurer. Hope there's something useful in there for you.
narrative.requestItemsText: You've proved you can handle yourself in a fight, adventurer. Let's keep the pressure up on the Twilight's Hammer. Go fight some more Abyssal Templars, I'll reward you with some of the stuff Huum and I have found in battle.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 6,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Abyssal Contacts
quests.objectiveText: Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed.
